candidate.answerReason: Since BC<AB, C lies either between A and B or beyond B. Segment subtraction gives 6 cm, and segment addition gives 14 cm.

methods.label: Segment addition and subtraction
methods.explanation: There are two cases: when C lies on the extension of AB, \(AC=10+4=14\); when C lies on segment AB, \(AC=10-4=6\).
